name: Altium 365 (through Nexar)
summary: Reads your Altium 365 workspaces and their design data through Altium's Nexar API, after you sign in. Read-only. Design data only appears if your projects are saved in an Altium 365 workspace. Confirmed from Nexar's documentation: the sign-in and token addresses, the scopes openid design.domain user.access, the GraphQL address, and the desWorkspaces query. Not confirmed: which redirect addresses Nexar accepts, and the exact field names (check them in Nexar's schema viewer, https://api.nexar.com/ui/voyager).

fields.label: Client ID
fields.where: portal.nexar.com, Apps, your app, Authorization tab, Credentials

fields.label: Client secret
fields.where: portal.nexar.com, Apps, your app, Authorization tab, Credentials

setup: Make sure your projects are in an Altium 365 workspace: in Altium Designer, sign in to your workspace and save the projects there. Without it, Nexar has no design data to return.
Sign in at portal.nexar.com with your Altium account. New accounts get an Evaluation App with design access; open it from Apps.

In the app's Authorization tab, add the sign-in return address shown on this screen to the allowed redirect URLs. (Nexar's documentation doesn't say which addresses it accepts; if it refuses this one, tell External Service.)
Copy the Client ID and Client secret from the Credentials section into the fields here.
Press Sign in, sign in with your Altium account in the window that opens, then come back and press Test.

operations.name: list_workspaces
operations.description: The Altium 365 workspaces your account belongs to. Empty means no workspace is linked.

operations.name: run_query
operations.description: Any read-only GraphQL query on Altium 365 design data (des... queries), such as a workspace's projects or library. Check field names in Nexar's schema viewer first.
